scene.ko: 주말 아침 집 앞에서 이웃과 날씨 이야기로 시작해 정원 이야기로 대화를 이어 가다가, 약속 때문에 자연스럽게 마무리한다.

lines.en: Isn't this weather gorgeous? Finally, a sunny weekend!
lines.ko: 날씨 정말 좋지 않아요? 드디어 맑은 주말이네요!

lines.en: I know! After all that rain, it feels like a gift.
lines.ko: 그러니까요! 비가 그렇게 오더니, 선물 같아요.
alt: Right? After all that rain, it feels amazing.
It's beautiful! It feels great after all the rain.

lines.en: I'm meeting a friend for a picnic by the river. How about you, Diane? I noticed you've been working on your garden.
lines.ko: 친구랑 강가에서 피크닉하기로 했어요. 다이앤 씨는요? 요즘 정원 가꾸시는 거 봤어요.
alt: I'm having a picnic with a friend by the river. What about you? I saw you working in your garden.

lines.en: Oh, yes! The tomatoes are finally coming in. Last year, the squirrels got every single one, so this year I put up a little fence, and then...
lines.ko: 아, 맞아요! 토마토가 드디어 열리기 시작했어요. 작년엔 다람쥐들이 하나도 안 남기고 다 먹어서, 올해는 작은 울타리를 쳤는데, 그랬더니...

lines.en: Ha, smart move. They look great. You've clearly put a lot of work into it.
lines.ko: 하하, 잘하셨네요. 정말 잘 자랐어요. 공을 많이 들이신 게 보여요.
alt: Good thinking! They look amazing. You must have worked really hard on it.

lines.en: Thank you! You know, I could give you some when they're ripe. Do you cook much?
lines.ko: 고마워요! 있잖아요, 익으면 좀 드릴게요. 요리 자주 하세요?

lines.en: I'd love that! I do, actually. I'm sorry to cut this short, but I promised my friend I'd be there by noon.
lines.ko: 그럼 너무 좋죠! 사실 자주 해요. 말씀 중에 죄송한데, 친구한테 12시까지 가기로 해서요.
alt: That would be great! Yes, I cook a lot. I hate to cut this short, but I told my friend I'd be there at noon.

lines.en: Oh, of course! Don't let me keep you.
It was great chatting with you. Good luck with the tomatoes!
lines.ko: 이야기 나눠서 즐거웠어요. 토마토 잘 키우세요!
alt: Nice talking with you! Good luck with the tomatoes.
Great catching up! I hope the tomatoes do well.

expressions.note: 상대에게 관심을 보여 대화를 이어 갈 때

expressions.en: You've put a lot of work into ___.
I'm sorry to cut this short, but ___.
expressions.note: 대화를 정중하게 끝낼 때 · I hate to cut this short 도 같음
바쁜 상대를 붙잡지 않고 보내 줄 때

expressions.en: It was great chatting with you.
